verdict.rationale: Datalab documents a no-credit-card free monthly allowance "enough to run a full proof of concept on your own documents" and a no-key Forge upload, so you can run your own evals before committing. A published Marker benchmark appears only indirectly, through community references to the vendor's own benchmark and GitHub comparison chart; no first-party benchmark docs, methodology or reproduction steps are in the pack. Missing for 10: first-party published accuracy benchmark documentation, evidence the benchmarks are reproducible (scripts/datasets), and independent corroboration of the benchmark results.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, the vendor publishes reproducible accuracy benchmarks and I can run my own evals before committing
